name: Mixpanel Cohorts
description: Mixpanel Cohorts groups product users by behavioral and profile criteria for analysis, comparison, and activation.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated project-scoped service account, select the US, EU, or India Query API region, and bind one project and workspace. Relay exposes one approval-gated read for saved cohort metadata and current counts; cohort members and profiles remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: MIXPANEL_COHORTS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_USERNAME
credentialRequirements.label: Mixpanel service-account username
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated project-scoped read-only service account.

credentialRequirements.name: MIXPANEL_COHORTS_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Mixpanel service-account secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay sends this only in Basic auth to the selected fixed Query API origin.

credentialRequirements.name: MIXPANEL_COHORTS_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: Mixpanel region
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter exactly us, eu, or in.

credentialRequirements.name: MIXPANEL_COHORTS_PROJECT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Mixpanel project ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind Relay to one non-production project.

credentialRequirements.name: MIXPANEL_COHORTS_WORKSPACE_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Mixpanel workspace ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind Relay to one non-production workspace.

capabilities.label: Read saved cohorts
capabilities.description: Read saved cohort metadata and current counts with approval.

approvalRequired.label: Read saved Mixpanel cohorts
approvalRequired.description: Read saved cohort names, descriptions, visibility, creation time, and current counts.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Service-account credentials, Basic authorization headers, project/workspace routing, and credential-bearing fields never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Read cohort members
blocked.description: Profiles, distinct IDs, identities, properties, events, cohort members, Engage queries, exports, and raw data are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate Mixpanel
blocked.description: Cohort creation/updates/deletes, profile/event/group changes, imports, reports, boards, annotations, flags, service accounts, and project administration remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only the official saved-cohort list POST runs on an enumerated US, EU, or India Query API origin with stored project/workspace binding; arbitrary input, routes, regions, auth modes, and oversized results are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The single cohort metadata/count read requires approval; exact project/workspace/region binding, response bounds, audits, and member/export/mutation blocks remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected cohort metadata/count read runs without Relay per-action approval; exact project/workspace/region binding, response bounds, audits, and member/export/mutation blocks remain enforced.

providerSetup.blocker: Mixpanel requires a customer organization, a dedicated service account assigned read-only access to one project/workspace, and the correct US, EU, or India residency. No console, account, service account, credential, project, workspace, cohort, profile, Railway environment, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated read-only staging service account outside this worker, configure its username, secret, region, project and workspace in Railway staging, then verify exact binding, cohort metadata/count read, approval/access denial, 1 MB response bound, 60-query/hour and five-concurrent limits, credential revocation, pause/disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Mixpanel's official Query OpenAPI pins US/EU/India server origins, Basic service-account/project-secret auth, POST /cohorts/list, required project_id, optional workspace_id, response fields, and rate/concurrency limits.

Mixpanel's current saved-cohort reference documents cohort names, IDs, counts, descriptions, creation dates and visibility, and directs member retrieval to the separate Engage profile endpoint excluded by Relay.
Mixpanel documents cohorts as computed behavioral/profile groups used across analysis and activation, establishing the sensitivity and provider-side mutation boundary.
